Hero / Hero-Block.purpose: Full-width brand statement at the top of a page: media (image/video) with an animated headline, optional eyebrow/subtitle, sub-content overlay and CTA actions. The single most brand-critical block.

variations.name: Standard image hero
variations.diff: Static background image in the media slot. The default hero used across product & editorial pages.

variations.name: Video hero (inline autoplay)
variations.diff: A muted, looping <video> replaces the background image. Needs poster frame, reduced-motion fallback and lazy source loading for LCP.

capabilities.name: Sticky / scroll-pinned media
capabilities.diff: Media pins while sub-content scrolls over it — scroll-driven, IntersectionObserver.

capabilities.name: Two-line animated headline
capabilities.diff: Headline split into two lines for a staggered reveal animation.

capabilities.name: Sub-content overlay
capabilities.diff: Secondary content layered over the hero (badges/copy).

capabilities.name: Eyebrow / subtitle
capabilities.diff: Small label above the main title.

capabilities.name: CTA actions bar
capabilities.diff: One or more CTA buttons in a dedicated container.

Teaser / Card.purpose: The universal content promo/navigation unit. Renders image + optional pretitle/title/description + optional CTA, and composes into 2/3/4-up grids and horizontal rails everywhere on the site.

variations.name: CTA teaser (with action link)
variations.diff: Includes explicit CTA link(s) — a promotional card that drives a click. The dominant teaser form.

variations.name: Descriptive teaser
variations.diff: Adds a body-copy paragraph under the title (editorial / feature promo).

variations.name: Title-only navigation teaser
variations.diff: Minimal tile — image + linked title only, no description or CTA. Used as menu/navigation tiles.

variations.name: Image Card (named component)
variations.diff: An explicitly named "Image Card" variant used inside product/model rails and grids.

capabilities.name: Image slot
capabilities.diff: Teaser leads with an image (vs text-only).

Carousel / Slider.purpose: Horizontal slider for media, product rails and spec switching. BRP uses one rich carousel component that bundles arrows, dot indicators, peek/blur edges, tabbed navigation and 5-second auto-advance.

variations.name: Standard media carousel
variations.diff: WCM core carousel driven by arrows + dot indicators.

variations.name: Tabbed carousel
variations.diff: Slides switched via tab controls instead of arrows — used for spec/feature switching on product pages.

capabilities.name: Peek / blurry edges
capabilities.diff: Adjacent slides peek in with a blur (product-rail styling).

capabilities.name: Auto-advance (5s)
capabilities.diff: Rotates automatically every 5s; must pause on interaction for a11y.

Accordion.purpose: Collapsible panels for dense content — specifications, support how-tos and FAQs. Core WCM accordion.

variations.name: Standard accordion
variations.diff: Single-open collapsible panel set (default).

variations.name: FAQ accordion
variations.diff: Q&A-styled accordion on support/FAQ pages (heading = question).

Gallery / Image Grid.purpose: Clustered image presentation — grids, lightbox galleries and marketing mosaics.

variations.name: Lightbox gallery
variations.diff: Image cluster that opens a modal/lightbox on click.

variations.name: Image grid
variations.diff: Fixed responsive grid of images (no lightbox).

variations.name: Tile mosaic
variations.diff: Mixed-size mosaic of feature/marketing tiles.

Video / Video Embed.purpose: Video delivery via YouTube façade, self-hosted WebM/MP4, hero background loops, or click-to-play modals.

variations.name: YouTube embed (façade)
variations.diff: Stores a YouTube id and swaps to an iframe on play — keeps LCP light.

variations.name: Self-hosted WebM/MP4
variations.diff: Local video source (webm/mp4), no third-party player.

variations.name: Inline hero background video
variations.diff: Muted autoplay loop used as a hero background.

capabilities.name: Click-to-play modal
capabilities.diff: Opens the video in a modal dialog.

Image (Core).purpose: Responsive core image bound to the AEM DAM/rendition service, with lazy-loading and optional Scene7 delivery.

variations.name: Responsive DAM image
variations.diff: srcset generated from AEM DAM renditions.

variations.name: Scene7 / Dynamic Media image
variations.diff: Served via Adobe Scene7 (smart-crop / auto-format).

capabilities.name: Focal-position modifiers
capabilities.diff: Controls focal point of background/cover images.

Iframe / BYO Configurator Embed.purpose: Embeds the external Build-Your-Own configurator application (product-finder service) and other third-party tools inside the page shell.

variations.name: BYO configurator embed
variations.diff: Full external configurator app (sitebuild-*.brp.zlthunder.net) embedded via iframe.

variations.name: Generic content iframe
variations.diff: Core iframe component for arbitrary embedded content.

capabilities.name: Locale parameterisation
capabilities.diff: Passes a locale param to localize the embedded app.

Dealer Locator / Map.purpose: Interactive Google Maps surfaces for finding dealers, plotting event locations and showing points of interest.

variations.name: Google Maps locator
variations.diff: Interactive map initialised with a Maps API key.

variations.name: Marker/pin dataset map
variations.diff: Map seeded with multiple marker/pin datasets (dealers/POIs).

variations.name: Single event-location map
variations.diff: Bound to one lat/lng for an event location.

Configurator Package Selector.purpose: In-page selector for model packages/trims that feeds the configurator and lead flows.

variations.name: Package lead selector
variations.diff: Selects a lead package/trim and captures intent.

variations.name: Multi-package chooser
variations.diff: Presents multiple packages/trims for comparison/selection.

Container / Section.purpose: Responsive grid/section wrapper (aem-Grid) and segment blocks that lay out all other content. Present on virtually every page.

variations.name: Container / Section
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

CTA / Button.purpose: Call-to-action buttons and action links that drive clicks throughout the site.

variations.name: CTA / Button
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Breadcrumb.purpose: Hierarchical breadcrumb navigation reflecting the deep IA (up to 7 levels).

variations.name: Breadcrumb
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Title / Heading.purpose: Standalone heading component (H1–H4) used for section titles.

variations.name: Title / Heading
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Text / Rich Text.purpose: Rich-text body copy authored via the WCM text component.

variations.name: Text / Rich Text
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Downloads (PDF list).purpose: Lists of downloadable PDF assets (brochures, manuals, spec sheets).

variations.name: Downloads (PDF list)
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Modal / Dialog.purpose: Overlay dialogs for videos, packages and expanded content.

variations.name: Modal / Dialog
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

variations.name: List
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Page-Level Navigation.purpose: In-page anchor navigation for long pages. Rare (4 pages).

variations.name: Page-Level Navigation
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

variations.name: Table
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Form.purpose: Lead-gen / quote / pre-order forms. Very rare (2 pages).

variations.name: Form
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.

Tabs.purpose: Horizontal tab component. Very rare (1 page).

variations.name: Tabs
variations.diff: Single standard form — no distinct variations observed in the DOM.
